description: Makes the Construction Stage Reporter plugin's own reports of the open model's construction stages and returns download links (never the file inline): the Excel workbook (summary, stage matrices for structure/boundary/load groups, group tables, stage details, composite sections, displacements, beam results, warnings) and the A4 PDF (cover, summary, matrices, one page per stage with a picture of CIVIL NX's own view of that stage from /view/CAPTURE, and the warnings). Construction-stage displacements (series, default Summation) are included when the analysis has been run; members (as cs_stage_results) adds one beam result component. The MP4 animation is not available here — use the plugin in CIVIL NX. Read-only, but the pictures make CIVIL NX show each stage in turn. Runs as a job.

includeLoads.description: Include the load group matrix and load columns.

maxSnapshots.description: With more stages than this, pictures for this many evenly spread stages.

members.description: Beam results of chosen members: {groups:[structure group names]} and/or {elements:[ids]} (only TYPE BEAM elements count), table 'BEAMFORCE' (default) or 'BEAMSTRESS', component (default Moment-y for forces, Cb(min/max) for stresses; heads such as Axial, Shear-z, Moment-y, Bend(+z), Cb1(-y+z), or short names My, Mz, Fx, Fz), part 'gov' (default: on composite members the governing section part at each position) or 1–4 (1 = girder, 2 = slab), series (default Summation). Composite members' stresses are read per section part (COMPSECTBEAMSTRESS), as the plugin does.

program.description: Program name printed on the reports, when CIVIL NX does not report its version.

snapshots.description: A picture per stage in the PDF from CIVIL NX (/view/CAPTURE).

name: cs_stage_report
title: Construction Stage Reporter — Excel / PDF report
